evals.name: dr-cta-automotive-15s
evals.prompt: I run a small auto detailing shop and want a 15 second direct-response style ad, hook problem solution cta, trying to get people to book an appointment this week
evals.expected_output: A certified T2VA prompt, 15s, Hook-Problem-Solution-CTA structure + Automotive category playbook, end-card reserved before body, hook under 3s, claim-cut rhythm every 2-3s, verbatim CTA text matching spoken CTA.

evals.name: bumper-finance-6s
evals.prompt: need a 6 second bumper ad for a budgeting app, insurance/finance category feel, trustworthy and calm
evals.expected_output: A certified T2VA prompt, 6s, 6-Second Bumper structure + Finance/Insurance/Pharma category playbook, brand/product visible within 1.0s, at most one cut, CTA embedded in the single message rather than a separate end-card beat.
